[EVENT] User is looking for healthy meal ideas for the week.  
[PREFERENCE] User enjoys making chili con carne and is thinking of making something similar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bean and lentil-based meals are delicious, packed with protein, fiber, and nutrients.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchiladas: Roasted sweet potatoes and black beans in whole wheat tortillas with spicy tomato sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl: Sautéed black beans, onions, bell peppers, and garlic over brown rice, topped with diced avocado and lime juice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. White Bean and Spinach Stew: Cannellini beans, spinach, garlic, and cherry tomatoes served with whole grain bread.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Indian-Style Red Lentil Curry: Red lentils, onions, ginger, garlic, and Indian spices served with brown rice or whole wheat naan.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Lentil and Vegetable Stew: Green or brown lentils with mixed vegetables and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Lentil and Mushroom Bolognese: Red lentils, mushrooms, onions, and tomatoes served with whole wheat spaghetti.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Vegan Chili: Plant-based chili with kidney beans, black beans, pinto beans, tomatoes, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Bean and Lentil Chili: A mix of beans and lentils, tomatoes, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Frijoles Refritos (Refried Beans): Pinto beans, onions, garlic, and spices.  
[PREFERENCE] User is thinking of using an Air Fryer to make crispy sweet potato fries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for making crispy sweet potato fries in the Air Fryer include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose high-starch sweet potatoes like Russet or Idaho.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cut sweet potatoes into long, thin strips (about 1/2 inch thick).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Soak sweet potato strips in cold water for at least 30 minutes and pat dry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Set Air Fryer to 400°F (200°C) and cook for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Don't overcrowd the basket; cook in batches if necessary.
